content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], Is there a way in the [product_name] to configure how many lines are in each CSV data file before a new one is created?

I only have the German manual for the current [product_name] in [version_no]. Here is the translated information: Note: - The [product_name] allows a CSV file to contain up to 20,000 lines. Once this limit is reached, the application automatically starts a new log file. - You can store up to 500 log files in one folder. If this number is exceeded, the oldest files are deleted first. - The standard version supports synchronization of 72 variables for all types. - Later versions are able to synchronize 75 consecutive or 7 discrete VMs; there are no upper limits for other variable types in these versions. - Variables that are not synchronized are marked as invalid data.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to control the number of rows each CSV data file can contain in the [product_name]. The answer clarifies that there is a fixed maximum of 20,000 rows per file set by the tool itself, with no user option to manually adjust this number. Automated file management is prioritized over giving manual control for CSV file generation, with additional limits on folder file quantity and variable synchronization described.
analysis.user_expectations: User is hoping for a manual configuration option to set the maximum row count for CSV files generated by the [product_name].
